'''Veeg Werdro''' was a famous [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Scout/Legends|space explorer]]. One of his routes was encrypted by a [[binary code cipher]] and was considered long-lost, although it was eventually rediscovered.<ref name="Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
